title: A Criterion for Phantomness of dg-categories
summary: We study the question of whether the vanishing of additive invariants characterizes phantomness for smooth proper dg categories admitting geometric realizations. More precisely, let $X$ be a smooth proper variety over a field $k$, and let $\sT\subset \perfdg(X)$ be a $k$-linear admissible full dg subcategory. We construct a non-compact motive $\sM(\sT)\in \DM(k,\Q)$ and show that its $l$-adic realization recovers the $K(1,l)$-local algebraic $K$-theory of $\sT$.
